text: {"alternatives":[{"component_id":"c6","service":"Storage","sku":"Cool LRS","details":"Blob Storage, General Purpose v2, Cool access tier, LRS, ~500 GB of invoice PDFs, North Europe","rationale":"Invoices are written once by the nightly job and rarely read afterwards, so Cool tier's lower per-GB capacity price beats Hot for ~500 GB of mostly-idle PDFs, while LRS in North Europe keeps data in the EU.","tradeoffs":["Higher read and write operation charges than Hot","30-day minimum retention charge for early deletion or tier change","Slightly higher access latency/lower SLA than Hot, acceptable for archived invoices"],"also_replaces":[]},{"component_id":"c6","service":"Storage","sku":"Hot LRS Lifecycle to Cool","details":"Blob Storage, General Purpose v2, Hot LRS for recent invoices (new writes) with a lifecycle policy moving blobs to Cool LRS after ~30 days, ~500 GB total, North Europe","rationale":"Keeps recently generated invoices on Hot for cheap frequent access while automatically shifting the bulk of older, rarely opened PDFs to the cheaper Cool tier.","tradeoffs":["Requires a lifecycle management rule to be configured","Tier-transition operations add a small cost","Savings are smaller than going fully Cool if most data is rarely read"],"also_replaces":[]}]}
